main:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Reads integer pairs, normalizes each pair to a canonical reduced vector, counts equivalent vectors, and computes a modular combinatorial count from perpendicular vector pairings and zero-axis vectors, then prints ans - 1 + count of (0,0)." main]
    [INPUTS]
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Read an integer n from standard input with int(input()) and store it in n. RESULT n]
            [COMMAND Initialize dic and dic1 as defaultdict(int) for counting normalized pairs. RESULT dic, dic1]
            [COMMAND For exactly n iterations, read a pair (a, b) with inpm() and normalize it: if a != 0 and b == 0, set a = 1; else if a == 0 and b != 0, set b = 1; else if both a and b are nonzero, divide both by gcd(a, b); leave (0, 0) unchanged. Then if (a < 0 and b < 0) or (a < 0 and b > 0), flip the signs of both a and b so that a is non-negative. Build the key as the string '<a> <b>', increment dic[key] by 1, and increment dic1[key] by 1. RESULT dic, dic1]
            [COMMAND Initialize ans to 1 and dic2 to defaultdict(int). RESULT ans, dic2]
            [COMMAND For each key e in dic, parse a and b from e.split() as integers. If a == 0 or b == 0, continue. Set flag = 0. If a > 0 and b > 0, set rev to the string '<b> <-a>'; otherwise set rev to the string '<-b> <a>'. If dic1[rev] > 0 and dic2[rev] == 0, set dic2[rev] = 1, dic2[e] = 1, and flag = 1. If flag is true, continue. Compute n1 = pow(2, dic[e], mod) and n2 = pow(2, dic1[rev], mod). If n1 == 0, multiply ans by n2; else if n2 == 0, multiply ans by n1; else multiply ans by (n1 + n2 - 1). Finally reduce ans modulo mod. RESULT ans, dic2]
            [COMMAND Initialize num to 0. RESULT num]
            [COMMAND If both dic['1 0'] and dic['0 1'] are truthy, set num = (pow(2, dic['1 0'], mod) + pow(2, dic['0 1'], mod) - 1) % mod; else if dic['1 0'] is truthy, set num = pow(2, dic['1 0'], mod) % mod; else if dic['0 1'] is truthy, set num = pow(2, dic['0 1'], mod) % mod; if none of these conditions is true, leave num unchanged at 0. RESULT num]
            [COMMAND If num != 0, multiply ans by num and reduce ans modulo mod. RESULT ans]
            [COMMAND Print the value ans - 1 + dic['0 0'] to standard output. RESULT stdout]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
